problemStatement.plain: Let f(N) be the size of the largest quasi-Sidon subset A ⊆ {1,...,N}, where A is quasi-Sidon if |A+A| = (1+o(1))·C(|A|,2). How does f(N) grow?
whyMatters: Open problem from Erdős (1981) asking for exact asymptotics of quasi-Sidon sets
Gap between lower bound 2/√3 ≈ 1.15 and Pikhurko upper bound ≈ 1.86 remains open

proven: Lower bound (Erdős-Freud 1991): f(N) ≥ (2/√3 + o(1))√N via Sidon set construction
open: Exact constant c such that f(N) = (c + o(1))√N

## Problem
Erdős Problem #840: quasi-Sidon subsets A ⊆ {1,...,N} with |A+A| = (1+o(1))C(|A|,2).
Open since 1981. Known: 1.15√N ≤ f(N) ≤ 1.86√N.

Built supporting infrastructure. Both files compile with acceptable sorries.
